children: Plurilock shareholders approved Quantum eMotion's acquisition of all outstanding shares for C$0.084 cash and 0.0763 QeM shares per Plurilock share, implying C$0.28 per share. Court approval is scheduled to be sought November 20, 2026; closing remains subject to conditions.
Approval advances the acquisition; the consideration combines C$0.084 cash and 0.0763 QeM shares per Plurilock share.
99.58% of votes cast backed the arrangement
Support exceeded the two-thirds approval threshold; excluding required shares, support was 99.54%.
Closing is not complete and remains subject to the court's final order and customary conditions.
Plurilock shares expected to be delisted after closing
Completion would end TSXV trading in Plurilock shares.

This is a mid-cycle milestone in the previously announced acquisition, following shareholder approval but before court approval and closing. The next catalyst is the court's final order and confirmation that remaining closing conditions are satisfied or waived.
